company.name: Material Security
company.shortDescription: Material Security is an email security company that develops data-driven security software to protect an organization's users and data.
company.description:
Material Security is an email security company that develops data-driven security software to protect an organization's users and data.
Material Security started Material after the 2016 hacks changed history and showed everyone everywhere the importance and fragility of our private data.

Material Security thinks it takes at least as much creativity to protect a technology as it does to invent it. We know that usable security means making people safe and productive. The company believes in common sense and not silver bullets, snake oil, or “next-generation” technobabble. Our goal is resilience, and we build security that works (and works simply).

Material Security partnered closely with the world’s best organizations to protect their employees and the ordinary people that depend on them. We work incredibly hard because keeping people safe and helping them collaborate is the best job in the world.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud workspace security platform for detecting, containing, and remediating threats across email, files, accounts, and workspace configurations in Google Workspace and Microsoft 365.
productsAndServices.name: Material Platform

productsAndServices.description: Detects and remediates malicious email threats that bypass native cloud email controls, including phishing, business email compromise, impersonation, and other post-delivery attacks.
productsAndServices.name: Email Security

productsAndServices.description: Identifies sensitive content in cloud files, monitors exposure, and automatically remediates excessive permissions and inappropriate sharing to reduce data sprawl.
productsAndServices.name: File Security

productsAndServices.description: Detects risky account behavior and account takeovers, strengthens cloud workspace accounts, and limits the impact of compromised credentials through containment controls.
productsAndServices.name: Account Security

aiResearchSummary.text: Material Security is researching systems for defanging malicious electronic files based on trusted user reporting, as well as methods for protecting contents and accounts using scan operations that evaluate emails against security rules and store sensitive data securely. They are also developing secure communications services for intercepting suspicious messages and tools for searching and accessing unredacted vaulted electronic communications. These efforts focus on email threat detection, secure storage, and information retrieval.
